data.name: BitSlaps
data.detailed_description:
Just Updated

MAJOR UPDATE IS HERE!

The biggest BitSlaps update is here! We've introduced brand-new game modes, built-in Voice Chat, an improved multiplayer lobby, and a variety of gameplay improvements to make every session even more fun.

Whether you're returning to the arena or jumping in for the first time, there's never been a better time to play!

New Game Mode: Board Games

Take a break from obstacle races and challenge your friends in our brand-new Board Games mode. Enjoy a collection of classic games, each offering its own unique multiplayer experience.

Chess

Put your strategy to the test in the world's most iconic board game. Plan every move, protect your king, and outsmart your opponent to claim victory.

Ludo

Race your tokens around the board, send your friends back to the starting area, and be the first player to bring all your pieces home. Simple to learn and always fun to play.

Backgammon

Roll the dice, make tactical decisions, block your opponent's progress, and race to bear off all your checkers before anyone else.

Snake Royale

A competitive twist on the classic Snake experience. Collect food, grow longer, avoid collisions, and become the last snake standing in an ever-shrinking arena.

More board games and exciting content are already planned for future updates!

Built-in Voice Chat

Communication just got better.

BitSlaps now includes built-in Voice Chat, making it easier than ever to coordinate with teammates, celebrate victories, or simply laugh together as chaos unfolds.

No third-party applications are required—just join a match and start talking.

Stream Chat Integration

Your audience becomes part of the game.

BitSlaps features seamless Stream Chat Integration, allowing viewers to join the action directly from your live stream.

When a viewer types !join in chat, their in-game character instantly spawns into the match with their username displayed above their character.

As they continue chatting, every message they send is updated above their character in real time, creating a unique interactive experience where the audience isn't just watching—they're actively participating in the chaos.

No extra setup for viewers is required. Simply start your stream, let your audience type !join, and watch your community come to life inside the game.

Improved Text Chat

Our in-game Text Chat has also been improved, making it easier to communicate with friends, organize matches, and stay connected before, during, and after every game.

Redesigned Multiplayer Lobby

We've completely redesigned the multiplayer lobby to provide a smoother and more polished experience.

The new lobby features:

  • A fresh, modern design

  • Better player interaction

  • Improved party management

  • Faster matchmaking flow

  • A smoother transition into every match

Playing with friends has never been easier.

Additional Improvements

This update also includes:

  • Gameplay improvements

  • Performance optimizations

  • Bug fixes

  • Quality-of-life enhancements

  • Continued support for Streamer Mode

  • Overall multiplayer improvements

Coming Soon

Development on BitSlaps continues, and we're already working on the next major update.

Steam Achievements

Unlock a wide variety of Steam Achievements by completing challenges, mastering game modes, winning matches, discovering secrets, and proving your skills across BitSlaps.

Whether you're a casual player or a completionist, there will be plenty of achievements to earn and proudly display on your Steam profile.

This is only the beginning. Even more content is already in development, including new maps, new game modes, additional powers, quality-of-life improvements, and exciting surprises for the community.

Thank You!

Thank you to everyone who has played, streamed, and supported BitSlaps. Your feedback, videos, livestreams, and suggestions continue to shape the future of the game.

We're just getting started, and we can't wait to share what's coming next.

Update today, invite your friends, jump into the chaos, and we'll see you in the arena! 


About the Game

THE ULTIMATE PARTY GAME FOR STREAMERS

BitSlaps is a FREE-TO-PLAY online multiplayer party game built for players, friends, and content creators.

Race through chaotic obstacle arenas, dodge deadly traps, outsmart your opponents, and unleash hilarious slap powers while your live audience joins the action in real time.

With support for up to 64 players, every match delivers physics-based chaos, unpredictable moments, and endless replayability.

No two games are ever the same.

BUILT FOR STREAMERS

BitSlaps isn't just another party game—it's built specifically for streamers.

With Streamer Mode, your viewers don't just watch...

They control the chaos.

Through YouTube, Twitch, and Kick, your audience can trigger gameplay events using:

  • Like Goals

  • Chat Activity Goals

  • Follow Goals

  • Subscriber Goals

These interactions activate powerful gameplay effects that can completely change the outcome of every match.

VIEWER POWERS

  • Left Slap — Knock players sideways. A perfectly timed slap can send anyone standing near an edge falling into the void.

  •  Right Slap — Push opponents into traps, interrupt jumps, or knock them off moving platforms.

  • Reverse Controls — Flip a player's controls, making simple obstacles suddenly become a challenge.

  • Freeze — Trap players inside ice, leaving them helpless while the race continues.

  • Power Jump — Launch players high into the air to escape danger... or straight into trouble.

  • Nuclear Blast — Create massive chaos by sending nearby players flying across the arena.

Every stream becomes a unique experience where viewers directly influence the gameplay and create unforgettable moments.

MULTIPLE GAME MODES

Whether you're racing through dangerous obstacle courses or relaxing with friends in classic board games, BitSlaps always offers something new to play.

Tumble Mode

Race to the finish while avoiding deadly traps, moving platforms, environmental hazards, and unpredictable slap attacks.

Maps

  • Original

  • FireLink

  • FireLink II

Shatter Walk

A high-risk survival mode where every platform may break beneath your feet.

Memorize the safe path, outsmart your opponents, and survive longer than everyone else.

Maps

  • Original

  • FireLink

Board Games

Take a break from obstacle races and challenge your friends in a growing collection of classic games.

  • Chess — Outsmart your opponent with strategy, planning, and tactical decision-making.

  • Ludo — Race your pieces home while sending your friends back to the starting area.

  • Backgammon — Roll the dice, make smart decisions, and outplay your rivals.

  • Snake Royale — A competitive multiplayer twist on the classic Snake game where only the last survivor wins.

More board games will be added in future updates.

VOICE & TEXT CHAT

Stay connected with built-in Voice Chat and Text Chat.

Coordinate strategies, organize matches, chat with friends, or simply enjoy the chaos together—all without leaving the game.

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

Unlock cosmetics and personalize your character to stand out from the crowd.

More customization options will continue to arrive through future updates.

CO-OP & FRIENDLY COMPETITION

Create private lobbies, join public matches, or invite your entire squad.

Work together...

Race each other...

Or betray your friends with the perfect slap.

In BitSlaps, teamwork is optional—but chaos is guaranteed.

REGULAR CONTENT UPDATES

BitSlaps continues to grow with regular updates featuring:

  • New Maps

  • New Game Modes

  • More Board Games

  • New Powers

  • Seasonal Events

  • Gameplay Improvements

  • Quality-of-Life Updates

  • Community-Driven Features

The chaos never stops.

KEY FEATURES

  • FREE-TO-PLAY

  • Built for Streamers

  • Interactive YouTube, Twitch & Kick Integration

  • Up to 64-Player Online Multiplayer

  • Physics-Based Party Gameplay

  • Viewer-Controlled Powers

  • Left & Right Slap Combat

  • Reverse Controls

  • Freeze Ability

  • Power Jump

  • Nuclear Blast

  • Tumble Mode

  • Shatter Walk

  • Board Games

  • Voice Chat

  • Text Chat

  • Dynamic Maps

  • Private & Public Lobbies

  • Character Customization

  • Regular Free Content Updates

  • Endless Replayability

YOUR AUDIENCE DOESN'T JUST WATCH... THEY CONTROL THE CHAOS.

Jump into the arena, invite your friends, stream the madness, and discover why BitSlaps is the ultimate multiplayer party game for players, creators, and communities.

With Twitch, YouTube, and Kick integration, viewers can join the action and create unforgettable moments of pure chaos.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 (1 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Low-end hardware may experience lower performance.Internet connection required for multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 265 or equivalent with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Stable broadband connection recommended for smooth online play.
